morphology.compounding_rule: Egyptian construct-chains (Per-[god] house/temple of, Niut-[god] city of, Ta-[noun] land of, Pa-[noun] the-) layered over shortened Plains descriptive compounds ([quality|animal] + feature: Eka-toya red-mountain, Kutsiwa-sonisekh bison-grassland): the capital Denalikem (the great-mountain of the Black-Land), Per-Tjuraa (temple-city of the sun), Ta-Puukib (the land of the horse).
morphology.patronymic_form: the Egyptian temple-stock keep the filiation 'sa' (son of) and theophoric given names on the morphed god-stems; the Plains horse-clans keep the band/division name and an earned deed- or vision-name; the throne fuses both - a nesut who carries a theophoric Per- name and a deed-cognomen from the herds.

patterns.dungeons_ruins: tombs and pyramids of the god-kings and old burial-scaffolds and spirit-haunted buttes of the plains: 'the Tomb of Per-aa [name]', 'the Sunken Per-netjer', 'the Medicine-Cairn of [chief]', 'the Ghost-Butte of [name]'
patterns.military_units: the [god] Division and the mounted warrior-societies: 'the Division of Rapetj', 'the Horse-Akicita of Denalikem', 'the Sun-Disc Companies', 'the Dog-Soldiers'
patterns.ships: solar-barques of the river and the great war-lances and herds of the plain: 'Barque of Tjuraa', 'Beloved of the River', 'the Red Lance', 'Cloud-Eater (a famed horse)'
patterns.taverns: 'The [Adjective] [Noun]': 'The Golden Lotus', 'The Red Crown Cup', 'The Bison and Sun-Disc'

religion._note: Deity-names are morphs of the Agrippan canon - Egyptian canon-morphs PRIMARY (abydosian sample_deity_renames, via Egyptian phonology: l->r, v->w, -us/-a -> -aa/-et, dj/tj/kh flavor), Plains canon-morphs SECONDARY (family_north_american theonym_sets.plains / numinan), never real Egyptian or Plains gods. Same shared pantheon, two name-sets for the two ancestries. Alignment any of Lawful/Neutral/Chaotic (per the 2026-06-27 update); the realm's stance follows its CURRENT alignment (see worship_by_alignment). The solar disc of the river-temple rides over the horse-and-eagle banner of the plains; the powers are met both in the built per-netjer of the river-cities and at the open-sky medicine-cairn of the herds.

clergy_ladder.7: Hem-netjer Tepy (first prophet/high priest) / Numunu-puhakatu (the band's high seer)
clergy_ladder.9: Hem-netjer Aa (great prophet) / Naika-puhakatu (the council's great seer)

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the Chaotic powers, warded as the -kin of the great serpent Hefau (Egyptian) or under dread Plains epithets, keep their morphs + an epithet: Maraxus -> Marakhu the City-Burner (Plains Maraksa the war-fire, the raider); Vacidus -> Wakedjet the Devouring Hefau (Plains Vachita the void); Dementus -> Tamawi the storm-thunder; Lusanto -> Lusanta the Hoard-Worm.

holy_symbol_motifs.Oranetj: an iron spear crossed with the war-lance of the herds
holy_symbol_motifs.Rapetj: the red hunter's bow beneath the open plains sky
holy_symbol_motifs.Tjuraa: the sun-disc above the feather of right-order, over the horse-and-eagle banner

religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Per-netjer (god's-house/temple) of [power] in the river-cities, and the open-sky medicine-cairn of [power] on the high plain: 'the Per-netjer of Tjuraa', 'the Medicine-Cairn of Maraksa'.
religion.saints_pattern: the deified dead (akhu) and god-kings of the river, 'the justified [name]' (maa-kheru), venerated at tomb-temples; and the great chiefs and vision-seers of the plains who became sky- and animal-spirits, honored at the burial-scaffold and the medicine-cairn.

Raptis.gloss: the red hunter of the herds

religion.the_one: Atjernaa (Egyptian; Plains Ateruna) - the hidden distant maker, honored not petitioned

worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: Venerates the Chaotic powers of the canon (Marakhu the city-burner, Maraksa the war-fire, the storm and the greed-serpent), and names the Lawful powers - and Atjernaa - as the cold sun-tyrants and chain-gods to be defied.
worship_by_alignment.Lawful: venerates the Lawful powers - Atjernaa, Tjuraa the just sun, Oranetj of the sworn war, Riaret the merciful, Gayandaa the enduring earth - through the river-temple's offerings and the law of right-order (maat); names the Chaotic powers the -kin of the great serpent Hefau, warded; the solar disc and the medicine-cairn bind alike
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: the deified dead (akhu) and god-kings of the river-cities, and the ancestral chiefs and animal-spirits of the plains; the great powers invoked at the per-netjer and the open-sky medicine-cairn situationally, all somewhat honored and somewhat feared

titles._tiers_note: Egyptian ladder, ascending, with the Plains horse-clan honors beneath. Hatia (mayor) barony; Wer-khaset (great-one of the frontier-land) march; Sepati/Sepat (nomarch/nome) county; Mer-mesha (army-overseer/general, leading the mounted akicita) duchy; Heqa-aa (great ruler) principality; Nesut (king) kingdom - DISPLAYED with the approved foreign term 'Pharaoh'; Per-aa (the Great House) empire over the Per-aat. The Plains clans keep their paraibo (peace-chief) and tekwuniwap (war chief) and the akicita warrior-societies beneath the solar crown; the wab and hem-netjer priesthood and the puhakatu medicine-seers stand outside the ladder. Rank titles are the real Egyptian register with the Plains substrate honors (allowed); the kingdom DISPLAY 'Pharaoh' is an approved commonly-known foreign term.
titles.display_policy: Ruler/domain titles shown in setting-gen, domain lists and vassal trees are ENGLISH (or an approved commonly-known foreign term where set in 'ruler'). The *_native conlang forms are for NPC DIALOGUE ONLY, never for structural/UI displays.
titles.government: feudal (an Egyptian temple-kingship over the Plains horse-clans: the per-aa god-king and his nesut-crown at the throne, the sepati-nomarchs over the river-nomes, the mer-mesha army-overseers leading the akicita horse-host; the hem-netjer priesthood and the per-netjer temple-scribes reckon and administer beneath, the paraibo clan-chiefs furnish the riders and herds)
titles.heir: Sa-Nesut (king's son / crown prince); Iry-pat (hereditary heir)
